newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am plans Airbus for JFK-Santo Domingo.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am plans Airbus for JFK-Santo Domingo.

text.p: Four weeks after launching its service between New York and Santo Domingo, Pan Am World Airways said it will replace the Boeing 727 now used on the route with a larger Airbus A300B4-200 with effect from May 15.
The decision to introduce the Airbus reflected the level of passenger demand, Pan Am executive, William Elio told Reuters.
This demand has meant that there has been no available cargo space during the past four weeks but the Airbus is expected to provide around two tonnes of cargo capacity on the outward journey.
However on the leg from the Dominican Republic, between four and six tonnes will be available, reflecting smaller passenger baggage requirements on the return flight to New York, he added.
